description: Installation of three air conditioning condensor units and one back-up diesel generator to be enclosed with fencing and a gate
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (284 003 013a, 284 003 002. Received: 08/04/2019. 284 003 002. Received: 11/06/2019. PHOTO: Example Acoustic Enclosure, PHOTO: Jacksons Fencing Euroguard Combi. Received: 07/10/2019. 195425/4, 284 003 033 Rev. B, 284 003 034 Rev. A, 284 003 035, Noise Impact Assessment 14490-NIA-01 RevG prepared by clement acoustics dated 21 November 2019. Received: 21/11/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The three air conditioning units hereby approved shall not be operated until the acoustic enclosure recommended by the Noise Impact Assessment prepared by clement acoustic dated 21 November 2019 is installed. The acoustic enclosure shall be retained for the lifetime of the development.

Condition : 4 - The three air conditioning units hereby approved shall be designed and installed to ensure that noise emanating from such plant is at least 10dB below the background noise levels when measured from the nearest sensitive receptors. No further external plant shall be installed without the written prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.
